headline: Rain forecast for 5 days: Rainfall to continue nationwide with heavy rain in north
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department predicts continuous rain across the country for the next 120 hours, with very heavy rainfall expected in the northern regions.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has announced that rainfall will continue across the country for the next 120 hours starting from Saturday morning.
According to meteorologist Dr. Muhammad Abul Kalam Mallik, the monsoon is active over the country, leading to this extended period of precipitation.
For Saturday, light to moderate rain or thunderstorms are expected in most parts of Rangpur, Mymensingh, Chattogram, and Sylhet, and in many parts of Rajshahi, Dhaka, Khulna, and and Barishal.
The BMD warns of heavy to very heavy rainfall in some parts of the Rangpur division, specifically for Saturday.
From Sunday to Wednesday, light to moderate rain or thunderstorms will continue in most divisions, with moderate to heavy or very heavy rainfall possible in various parts of the country.
Temperatures are expected to remain largely unchanged for the next few days, though a slight decrease may occur on Monday and Tuesday.
The weather office has also indicated that the trend of rainfall is likely to persist even after the next five days.
caption:
Get your umbrellas ready! Nationwide rain is forecast for the next 120 hours.

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has announced that rainfall will continue across the country for the next 120 hours starting from Saturday morning.

According to meteorologist Dr. Muhammad Abul Kalam Mallik, the monsoon is active over the country, leading to this extended period of precipitation.

For Saturday, light to moderate rain or thunderstorms are expected in most parts of Rangpur, Mymensingh, Chattogram, and Sylhet, and in many parts of Rajshahi, Dhaka, Khulna, and and Barishal.

The BMD warns of heavy to very heavy rainfall in some parts of the Rangpur division, specifically for Saturday.

From Sunday to Wednesday, light to moderate rain or thunderstorms will continue in most divisions, with moderate to heavy or very heavy rainfall possible in various parts of the country.

Temperatures are expected to remain largely unchanged for the next few days, though a slight decrease may occur on Monday and Tuesday.

The weather office has also indicated that the trend of rainfall is likely to persist even after the next five days.

headline: PMO to hold press conference marking five months in office
summary: The Prime Minister's Office is organizing a media briefing to mark the completion of five months of the current administration's tenure.
details: The Prime Minister's Office (PMO) has announced that it will hold a press conference to mark five months in office.
This media briefing is intended to provide updates on the administration's progress and milestones achieved during the first five months of its tenure.
